component.name: Takto
component.summary: A stable and customizable GNOME metronome

description.p: Takto keeps precise rhythm on stage and in the practice room. Timing lives in the audio callback, not in a GUI timer: beats are planned in audio samples over a continuous output stream, so the click stays rock-solid even while the interface repaints.

ul.li: 20–300 BPM with smooth, click-free tempo changes and tap tempo
Beat muting for building your own subdivision exercises
18 built-in click samples, from woodblock to cowbell
Native libadwaita interface with light and dark theme support

screenshot.caption: Main window with time signatures, tempo, beat indicators and sample presets

description.p: Rename the project to Takto, refresh branding and screenshots, preserve settings from the previous config directory, and add a pinned Flathub manifest.
Add Flatpak packaging: installable bundle on GitHub Releases and CI validation.
Name the desktop entry after the application ID and polish the app screenshot.
Initial release: 20–300 BPM metronome with tap tempo, accent patterns for common time signatures, beat muting, 19 built-in samples, and persistent settings.
